text: Nia starts at the council planning office on Monday. Nervous about the commute more than the job tbh. Text her that evening to see how day one went
pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before end of the month, ring the dentist about moving my checkup
Keisha got the promotion!! Team lead from early March. Her mum's apparently already told the whole street
lachlan leaving drinks fri at the Crown. hes off to a startup in leeds, starts the week after

Had coffee with Sara and her brother Hemi. Hemi's just been made redundant, found out the day before his birthday which is grim. Sara says he's putting a brave face on it but she's worried. I should check in with him sometime next week, nothing heavy, maybe just invite him for a pint.
Elif retiring at Christmas after 31 yrs at the hospital. Party being planned for the Saturday afterwards, Laila's organising. Chip in for a gift

So Oliver mentioned his dad is having his knee done in early November and Oliver's taking a fortnight off to look after him. He's the only one nearby, his sister's in Perth. Really stretched by it all.
Note to self: book MOT, it runs out mid November. And sort the boiler service over the summer next year, not leaving it till the cold again
Aidan's new job fell through, company pulled the offer. He's gutted. Ring him tomorrow
Niamh's daughter Rosa started nursery last week and apparently cried every morning but loved it by Thursday. Niamh back at work full time from the 1st.
Kerry Andersson — head of finance now. Wants to do a proper celebration over the summer when things calm down
Florin (Flo) says his wife Lindiwe is expecting, due end of April. First baby. He's over the moon and terrified
don't forget to email Damian the references before his interview thurs, he needs them the day before at the latest
Marisol's first day at the bakery went fine apparently. She's on early shifts, 5am starts. Her partner Pedro is doing the school run now
Kieran and his wife Gemma are moving to Bristol sometime in the spring, she's got a transfer with her firm. He'll look for something once they've settled.
Hugo got passed over for the promotion again. Third time. Says he's done and is going to start looking. Struggling a bit honestly.
Liam's mum Francesca retires end of the month. Liam wants to surprise her with a meal the weekend after, asked if I could help find a restaurant

voice note. um so Dafydd rang, he's had the call back for the second interview at the uni, it's sometime next week, he doesn't know the day yet. He's really anxious about the presentation part. I need to send him that article on the panel format and then wish him luck the morning of.
Rachel's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all fine, home that evening
Afua mentioned she's into pottery now, does a class Tuesdays. Wants a wheel of her own eventually, could be a birthday thing
Lior's last day at the agency is Friday. Not celebrating, leaving on bad terms with his manager. Starts at the new place two weeks later
groceries, return the parcel, gym 6pm. Ask about council tax rebate

Esther told me her son Mihai's graduating in July, and then he starts a grad scheme in Manchester in September. She's proud but sad he's moving away. Her husband's retiring the same summer so it's a lot of change for them.
Jaya and Tanvi's housewarming has been called off, Tanvi's dad is in hospital. They'll rearrange. Should text Jaya and see how he's doing
Keisha's brother Kieran started as a paramedic. First shift was last night apparently, 12 hours. Ask her how he found it
Reminder: take Mum's watch to be repaired, before her birthday in early December
Sara Moreau, from accounts — not Sara from book club — is going part time in January to look after her mother. Keep that in mind when scheduling.
Laila said Oliver proposed!! Engagement party end of Nov, date tbc. She wants a small one. I'm doing the cake
Damian's partner Hemi has a job interview at the BBC on the 14th. Damian says Hemi isn't nervous at all, which is very Hemi
Elif's grandson starts school next September. She's knitting him a book bag
Lachlan Gupta is our new neighbour at 14, teaches maths at the comp. Wife and two teenage boys. Very friendly, offered to lend the ladder
Pedro's got his probation review at the warehouse Thursday. If he passes he goes permanent. Text him afterwards
Florin's moving jobs again, this one's in Cardiff. His girlfriend isn't thrilled. Starts sometime after Christmas, maybe mid Jan

Call with Niamh. She's been offered the deputy head job at St Brigid's, starts after Easter. She's torn because it means leaving her class mid year and she adores them. Also her dad's not been well, some tests coming up end of the month, and she's going with him. Her husband Aidan is being supportive but he's flat out with his own work. I must ring her the week after the tests to see how her dad is, and maybe send flowers for the new job once it's official.
cancel gym membership!! auto renews on the 30th
Gemma said her mum's retirement do is the Saturday before Halloween. Gemma's speaking and dreading it
Kerry's son Liam has his driving test next Wednesday. Third attempt. Kerry's more nervous than he is
Marisol and Hugo celebrating 10 years married early next month, off to Lisbon for a long weekend
Note: Rosa doesn't eat meat, and Lior is coeliac. For the leaving lunch next week
Tanvi's new role at the bank starts the 3rd, she's moving to the risk team. Asked her to let me know how the first week goes

Spent ages on the phone with Rachel. Her sister Keisha just got the job in Dubai, leaves in early January, and Rachel's taking it hard because their mum is poorly and now it's all on her. She cried a bit. Keisha has no idea how upset Rachel is. Rachel's coming round Sunday, I'm cooking.
Mihai has been made manager of the Bridge St branch! Starts the role next month. Send him a card
Ok so Hugo's wife Francesca — Fran — got the head chef job at that new place on the quay. Opening night is sometime in mid November. Hugo said they'll get us tickets
Buy printer ink, post Dafydd's birthday card by Wed. His bday is the Friday
Afua's starting her PhD in Glasgow in October. Moving up there the week before. She's nervous about the money side

Esther's husband retired yesterday. 40 years at the post office. Big do at the social club afterwards, which I missed because of the flat viewing. She said he's already bored and has started reorganising the shed. Their daughter Nia is flying back from Toronto the week after to see them both. Call Esther at the weekend to apologise
Remember Jaya's allergic to nuts
Nia's cat Pickle went missing on Saturday, turned up three days later at the vets down the road. Microchip saved the day

Oliver started at the hospital as a junior doctor this week. Brutal rota. Lives with his brother Aidan for now, sleeping on the sofa bed, which isn't helping. Their mum keeps sending food parcels. He looked exhausted when I saw him on Sunday and said the first night shift is the day after his birthday. Don't forget to check in on him end of next week
Aidan Schmidt said Laila's retiring early. She hasn't said anything to the team so keep quiet
lindiwe said shed love one of those fancy coffee grinders. xmas idea

Kieran - leaving the police after 22 years. Leaving do on the 8th, and the next day he flies to Spain for a month. Thinking of retraining as a carpenter when he's back, already done a woodwork evening course. His wife Jaya is relieved, she never liked the night shifts. Must get a card signed by everyone before the 8th
Dentist moved to Tues 10am. Then pick up prescription afterwards. Parents eve Thurs

Talked to Gemma Nguyen about her daughter Elif, who just got into Oxford for medicine. Gemma's thrilled, Elif's dad not so much about the fees. Elif starts next October, they'll do a family trip over the summer before she goes.
Francesca's interview went well, they want her back for a second round sometime next week. Wish her luck the day before
Lior and Rosa are getting married in June! Hen do in Lisbon early May
Need to ring Pedro about his mum's funeral arrangements. It's on the 2nd, and the wake straight after at their house

New job update from Damian: he started Monday, hates the open plan office, loves the people. Probation ends end of January. His boss Marisol seems decent, she took the whole team out for lunch on his first day. He's commuting in by bike now and says he's lost half a stone already. He still hasn't heard back about the flat in Clifton, should hear sometime this week
Mrs Banerjee next door had a fall, she's in for a few days. Her son Hemi is staying at hers to feed the cats. I'll take round some food tomorrow

Book train to Edinburgh for early March, and the hotel. Look at cheap flights back the day after. Also need to sort a cat sitter for those days, and renew my passport over the summer because it runs out next autumn. Car insurance renewal end of the month too, compare before it rolls over
